text_a: El pago se procesa en 24 horas, ¿no?
text_b: El pago se procesa en 24 horas, ¿no es así?

text_a: The report was sent on Monday, wasn't it?
text_b: The report wasn't sent on Monday, was it?
what_differs: The polarity of the claim flips under the tag.

text_a: O arquivo já foi enviado, certo?
text_b: O arquivo já foi enviado, não foi?

text_a: El cliente ya pagó, ¿verdad?
text_b: El cliente ya pagó, ¿no crees?
what_differs: ¿no crees? invites an opinion, while ¿verdad? asks for confirmation of a fact.

text_a: Keep the door locked during the shift.
text_b: Keep the door unlocked during the shift.
what_differs: Locked versus unlocked reverses the required state.

text_a: Envía el informe antes del viernes.
text_b: Manda el informe antes del viernes.

text_a: Mantenha o equipamento ligado durante a noite.
text_b: Mantenha o equipamento desligado durante a noite.
what_differs: Ligado versus desligado reverses the required state.

text_a: Approve the expense report by Friday.
text_b: Sign off on the expense report by Friday.

text_a: Staff must wear badges on site.
text_b: Staff should wear badges on site.
what_differs: Must states an obligation, while should states a recommendation.

text_a: Es obligatorio firmar el formulario de entrada.
text_b: Hay que firmar el formulario de entrada.

text_a: Recomenda-se fazer backup antes da atualização.
text_b: Deve-se fazer backup antes da atualização.
what_differs: Recomenda-se is softer than deve-se, but how much softer is unclear.

text_a: Los visitantes no necesitan firmar el registro.
text_b: Los visitantes no pueden firmar el registro.
what_differs: No necesitan means not required, while no pueden means prohibited.

text_a: Only managers can approve refunds.
text_b: Managers can only approve refunds.
what_differs: The first restricts who may approve, the second restricts what managers may do.

text_a: Solo el administrador puede borrar cuentas.
text_b: El administrador es el único que puede borrar cuentas.

text_a: Somente os pais podem autorizar a saída.
text_b: Os pais somente podem autorizar a saída.
what_differs: The first restricts who may authorize, the second restricts what parents may do.

text_a: Just restart the router if the light blinks.
text_b: If the light blinks, just restart the router.

text_a: Lock the cabinet after you finish the audit.
text_b: Lock the cabinet before you finish the audit.
what_differs: After and before reverse the order of the two steps.

text_a: Primero limpia el filtro y después enciende la máquina.
text_b: Limpia el filtro; luego enciende la máquina.

text_a: Assine o contrato assim que o cliente aprovar a proposta.
text_b: Assine o contrato enquanto o cliente aprova a proposta.
what_differs: Assim que orders signing after approval, while enquanto may allow overlap.

text_a: Una vez termine la copia de seguridad, borra los archivos temporales.
text_b: Mientras corre la copia de seguridad, borra los archivos temporales.
what_differs: Una vez requires waiting until the backup ends, mientras allows deleting during the backup.

text_a: Notify the team leads and the auditors or the client.
text_b: Notify the team leads and either the auditors or the client.
what_differs: Without clear grouping, A and B or C could mean (A and B) or C, or A and (B or C).

text_a: Notifica a los socios y a los auditores.
text_b: Notifica a los socios o a los auditores.
what_differs: Y requires notifying both groups, o requires notifying one of them.

text_a: Assine ambos os formulários antes de sair.
text_b: Assine os dois formulários antes de sair.

text_a: You can't use either the elevator or the stairs during the drill.
text_b: You can't use the elevator or the stairs during the drill.

text_a: Espera veinte minutos antes de volver a intentarlo.
text_b: Espera 20 minutos antes de volver a intentarlo.

text_a: Wait 2 hours before retrying.
text_b: Wait 2 minutes before retrying.
what_differs: Hours versus minutes changes the required wait by a factor of 60.

text_a: Cobre cerca de 1.000 reais por mês.
text_b: Cobre cerca de 1,000 reais por mês.
what_differs: The separator convention for 1.000 versus 1,000 is unclear and could be read as 1 real.

text_a: Ofrece un descuento del 15 %.
text_b: Ofrece un descuento de 15 euros.
what_differs: A percentage discount differs from a fixed amount in euros.

text_a: Archive the old emails after the review.
text_b: Move the old emails to the archive after the review.

text_a: Delete the old emails after the review.
text_b: Archive the old emails after the review.
what_differs: Delete removes the emails permanently, while archive keeps them retrievable.

text_a: Revisa las cifras con el auditor antes del cierre.
text_b: Valida las cifras con el auditor antes del cierre.
what_differs: Revisar and validar overlap, but validar may imply formal approval.

text_a: Adie a reunião para a próxima semana.
text_b: Cancele a reunião da próxima semana.
what_differs: Adiar moves the meeting to another date, while cancelar removes it.

text_a: Solo puedes entrar si tienes credencial.
text_b: Puedes entrar si tienes credencial.
what_differs: Solo makes the credential necessary, while the other version does not restrict entry to credential holders.

text_a: Solo podrás salir si entregas la llave.
text_b: Podrás salir únicamente si entregas la llave.

text_a: Você recebe o reembolso mesmo sem o recibo.
text_b: Você recebe o reembolso desde que tenha o recibo.
what_differs: Mesmo sem makes the receipt unnecessary, while desde que makes it required.

text_a: The discount applies whenever you order online.
text_b: The discount applies if you order online.
what_differs: Whenever suggests every occurrence qualifies, while if is open to a one-time reading.

text_a: The system no longer accepts cash.
text_b: The system does not accept cash yet.
what_differs: No longer implies it used to accept cash, while not yet implies it may accept cash later.

text_a: Nunca se deben compartir las contraseñas.
text_b: No se deben compartir nunca las contraseñas.

text_a: Ainda não recebemos o pagamento.
text_b: Não recebemos mais o pagamento.
what_differs: Ainda não means payment is pending, while não mais means it was received before and no longer arrives.

text_a: Scarcely any of the forms were complete.
text_b: Hardly any of the forms were complete.
